race.comment: LOCHINVAR ANGEL (3) is a talented dog who was a fast winner last time with a dominant 3.5 lengths win (25.77) at this track. Form here at the trip excellent including four wins. Has a win and two minor placings from three starts from this draw. Well placed and can measure up. CRYSTAL (1) has some solid form under her belt and proved too classy last time to win by a nose at Launceston in a handy 29.81 beating Aariella's Girl. Recorded one of the quickest times on the card in scoring last start. One of the leading chances again. AYLA ZORRO (2) was an upset winner last time when scoring at big odds in a Other at Launceston (30.59). Makes plenty of appeal if runs up to latest. CRAZY SMART (6) is very honest and looms as a strong top-three hope again.

runners.name: Crazy Smart
